gloss: to be in charge of; to take charge

definitions.gloss: to be in charge of; to take charge of
definitions.explanation: To have responsibility for a task, class, area, or group of people.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{三年生|さんねんせい}のクラスを{受|う}け{持|も}っている。
examples.english: She is in charge of the third-grade class.

examples.japanese: このプロジェクトは{誰|だれ}が{受|う}け{持|も}つのですか。
examples.english: Who will be in charge of this project?

examples.japanese: {関西|かんさい}{地区|ちく}を{受|う}け{持|も}っています。
examples.english: I'm in charge of the Kansai region.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{受|う}ける (to receive) + {持|も}つ (to hold)

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラスを{受|う}け{持|も}つ: to be in charge of a class
- {担当|たんとう}を{受|う}け{持|も}つ: to take on a responsibility
- {地域|ちいき}を{受|う}け{持|も}つ: to be in charge of an area

RELATED NOUN:
- {受|う}け{持|も}ち: one's charge, assignment

SIMILAR VERBS:
- {担当|たんとう}する: to be in charge of (more formal)
- {任|まか}される: to be entrusted with
